title: Regulation A+ Improvement Act of 2025
committees: H-Financial Services Committee: Referred To 2025-12-09 -> Markup By 2025-12-16 -> Markup By 2025-12-17 -> Reported By 2026-02-25
latest_action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 451.
summary: Regulation A+ Improvement Act of 2025 This bill increases the aggregate dollar limit of certain securities offerings exempt from registration requirements (i.e., Regulation A+ offerings) from $50 million annually to $150 million annually, adjusted in future years for inflation.

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
